about_the_game:
How far would you go to save someone you love—when you can’t even trust your own memories?

"A young woman has vanished without a trace, reopening the haunting case of your own lost sister. In the storm-washed streets of a coastal town, you are Alex Hart—a detective running from your own past.

Every lead pulls you deeper into a web of suspicion. The people you meet may become your partners, your lovers, or your downfall. With each choice, trust becomes a luxury—and the line between reality and obsession blurs dangerously thin.

Features

  • Living, breathing mystery: Experience a cinematic visual novel where every twisted relationship reshapes the narrative, and every chilling clue forces you to question everything—especially your own sanity and the very nature of reality.

  • Consequences that cut deep: No choice is without a devastating cost. Every decision shapes your investigation, your relationships, and the terrifying truths that come to light—leading to four profoundly distinct endings that redefine fate.

  • Romance in the shadows: Navigate desire tangled with deception. Will love save you, or drag you deeper into darkness?

  • Psychological depth: Delve into the abyss of your own mind, battling fractured memories, unyielding trauma, and the creeping realization that the real danger might be a truth too terrible to remember—or to face.

  • Secrets within secrets: Beyond the surface, multiple playthroughs unveil hidden layers—missed clues, shifting perspectives, and the true, often horrifying, nature of everyone involved (including yourself).

  • High replayability: Uncover four entirely separate storylines with intricate branching subpaths, offering 15-20 hours of total content. Each playthrough promises fresh choices, shocking revelations, and unique emotional consequences—ensuring no two experiences are truly the same.

In this town, every truth demands a sacrifice. Every bond leaves its indelible mark.
Will you find her before you lose yourself—or your sanity—completely?

Note: This game contains mature themes, psychological tension, and suggestive content. Recommended for mature audiences (17+).

🎧 Want behind-the-scenes sneak peeks and exclusive updates? Join our Discord!

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature themes, suggestive content, and emotional intensity, including trauma, violence, and psychological manipulation. All intimate content is consensual and integral to the narrative. Recommended for mature audiences (17+) only.
